def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end

  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    nil
    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if false
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || nil
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url

    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_s
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if self.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_str.empty?
      nil
    else
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    if archive_url.to_s.empty?
      nil
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def archive_url_for(url)
  ArchiveHelper.archive_cache[url] ||= begin
    log_info("Looking up archive for #{url}")
    archive_url = lookup_archive(url)
    log_info("Archive URL: #{archive_url || ""}")
    if archive_save_enabled?
      log_info("Submitting to SavePageNow: #{url}")
      archive_url = submit_archive(url) || archive_url
      log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    end
    unless archive_url.to_s.empty?
      archive_url
    end
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive lookup failed for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = cdx_url_str
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = url
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(nil)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = nil
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{nil}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = self.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{nil}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = nil
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")

    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, self.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, nil, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: nil == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1

  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e

  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  archive_url

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: nil, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == nil, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 29) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"

  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: nil, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    raise
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri)
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get)
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(self.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new)
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless true
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless Net::HTTPSuccess
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  (log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}"); return nil)
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless false
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug(nil)
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = response.body
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  nil
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if self.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(self.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if nil <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(nil)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = self.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length == 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length.equal?(1)
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= nil
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 0
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 2
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if false
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1

  latest = rows
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = self.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = nil
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")

  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = self[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{nil}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  archive_url

  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = nil
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last

  nil
end

  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  nil
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  nil
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))

  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)

    return nil

  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1

  timestamp = latest[0]

rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end
